criteria.criterion: With a stubbed Steps, a drain whose only landing changed paths outside studies/, the site generator and the page sources, with the rating at the target, does not stop as "target met". The report says the landing did not change the outcome. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.
criteria.evidence: Test a_landing_outside_the_explainers_sources_cannot_meet_the_target_even_at_the_rating passed (33/33 in the drain suite). With rating 5 and a landing that changed only README.md and drain.rs, it asserts stop != TargetMet and outcome_changed == false. It also asserts the displayed report contains "no landing changed the outcome" and not "target met", and that check_page was never called. The code path is Drain::rate in drain.rs: when outcome_landings == 0 it returns None before the check.

criteria.criterion: A landing that changes a study file or the site generator, then a rating at the target and a passing source check, still stops as "target met". Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria.evidence: These tests passed: a_later_landing_that_changes_a_study_meets_the_target_after_an_unrelated_one, two_items_are_landed_and_then_a_rating_of_four_meets_the_target, and the end-to-end the_real_steps_work_a_queued_request_land_it_and_only_then_rate_the_page. The end-to-end test's job now creates studies/demo files, RealSteps::land reads the changed paths from the candidate record, and the test asserts TargetMet. the_site_generator_is_an_outcome_changing_path and the unit test only_paths_the_explainer_is_built_from_change_the_outcome cover xtask/.

criteria.criterion: Tests inject one wrong statement into each of claims.json, the intro, the transition and a glossary entry (for example teardown closes instead of can reopen; yolo-on allows self-merge; wrong handoff frees a place), plus one omitted fact. With a fake agent and stub pinner, RealSteps::check_page fails each time and names the statement, and drain does not report "target met". Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria.evidence: a_wrong_statement_in_any_page_text_input_fails_the_check_and_is_named passed. It covers five cases: WRONG_CLAIM in claims.json, WRONG_INTRO, WRONG_TRANSITION and WRONG_GLOSSARY in intro.json, and the omitted FACT. Each case runs the real RealSteps::check_page through the fixture's fake agent and pinner. The test asserts !passed, that the detail names the statement and demo/<file>, and that cost > 0. It then runs drain with the real check (WithRealCheck) at rating 5 and asserts stop != TargetMet, that held_back names the statement, and that the display does not say "target met".

criteria.criterion: A code check and test fail if any text-bearing file in a study directory is not covered by the source check. A page with correct text in every file passes. Run `cargo test`.
criteria.evidence: Coverage is enforced in code. pin::is_page_text treats every file except STRUCTURAL_FILES (pin.json, validation.json) as text. check_study_text_inner fails when the checker's files_checked omits any file. These tests passed: a_file_the_checker_did_not_read_fails_the_check, a_text_file_added_to_a_study_is_checked_without_anyone_listing_it, every_file_of_the_shipped_study_is_page_text_except_the_two_structural_ones, the pin.rs unit test only_the_pin_and_the_rule_results_are_exempt_from_the_source_check, and a_page_with_correct_text_in_every_file_passes_the_source_check_with_one_verifier_call. I ran the workspace tests as `cargo test --workspace -q`, which covers `cargo test`.

criteria.criterion: The source check is budget-guarded: the reserve covers every model call it will make (one per study or a single call), drain stops as "budget spent" when it does not fit, and the cost is added to spent_usd. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria.evidence: RealSteps::check_cap returns the verifier cap (Caps.rate = budget.verifier_usd) times the number of studies. Drain::rate checks budget.fits(cap) before calling the check, returns BudgetSpent with a note if it does not fit, and calls budget.add(check.cost) afterwards. These tests passed: the_source_check_runs_only_when_its_whole_cap_fits_and_otherwise_drain_stops_as_budget_spent, what_the_source_check_costs_is_added_to_the_spend_even_when_it_fails (spent 1.5 = 0.8 + 0.7, whether the check passes or fails), and the_reserve_for_the_source_check_grows_with_the_number_of_studies (1 study → 1× cap, 3 studies → 3× cap).

findings.summary: A changed file is outside the expected deliverables list
findings.evidence: The diff adds a source_check field to Scenario, plus SourceJudge, page_text_files and a fake verifier branch for prompts starting "# Source check". These are test helpers that the deliverable tests in tests/drain.rs depend on, but this file is not on the expected deliverables list.

findings.summary: The source-check invocation is not committed as a record; its cost appears only in the drain report
findings.evidence: The reading assumed the checker is "recorded under a role that matches its verifier model and cap". The spec uses Role::Verifier with the verifier model and cap, but D100 says the invocation is not committed as a record (it belongs to no job). The spend is still counted in spent_usd, and the decision states this openly, but the records will under-count model spend.

findings.summary: athena.toml is on the deliverables list but unchanged
findings.evidence: git diff HEAD~1 --stat does not list athena.toml. No change was needed because the check reuses the existing verifier_usd cap, so this is not a defect.

summary: The change passes: it does what the retry asked and covers the intro text the last attempt missed. "Target met" now needs two more things. First, at least one landing in the run must have changed studies/, xtask/ (the site generator) or the publish workflow; the changed paths are read from the job's candidate record, and otherwise the report says no landing changed the outcome. Second, every study file except pin.json and validation.json must pass a model-backed check against the pinned source, so text files added later are covered without anyone listing them. That check makes one verifier-role call per study and fails on contradicted or omitted statements, naming them; the existing self-consistency check still runs first, at no cost. It is budget-guarded: the reserve is the verifier cap times the number of studies, drain stops as "budget spent" when that does not fit, and the cost is added to spent_usd. New tests inject a wrong statement into claims.json, the intro, the transition and a glossary entry, plus one omitted fact, and run the real check with the fake agent and stub pinner each time. The help text, module docs, Stop::TargetMet docs, README, decision D100 and CHANGELOG all state both rules. I ran `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`, `cargo test -p athena-cli` and `cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace && cargo test --workspace`; the chain's output was too large to read back, so I reran the workspace tests with `-q`, and all passed. These results are from the snapshot only. I found no blocker or major issue. There are two minor findings: tests/common/mod.rs changed but is not on the deliverables list (it holds test helpers the new tests need), and the checker's call is not committed as a record, so its cost appears only in the drain report.
